title: Flat internal modules under inverse image and coefficient isomorphism
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. For any morphism f:X→Y of schemes, commutative monoid objects R and S in abelian sheaves on the pro-étale sites of Y and X respectively, and a monoid isomorphism ρ:S→f*R, the functor Mod.mapModComap ρ, namely ambient inverse image on internal R-modules followed by restriction along ρ, preserves flat objects. Flat means exactness of tensoring with the module, in the internal module category. No finiteness, Noetherian, or flatness assumption on a residue quotient is required.

proof.text: Identify internal module sheaves with sectionwise module sheaves by the sectionModuleEquivalence. Identify the balanced tensor products by their universal properties: a balanced internal bilinear map is precisely a sectionwise bilinear map compatible with restriction, and sheafification gives the same universal object.

Apply the local finite-relation criterion: each finite relation in inverse image lifts locally to one filtered-colimit stage; eventual equality moves it to a stage where it vanishes. Flatness gives a local matrix factorization there. Pull back the covering and its matrices. The converse criterion proves flatness over f*R, and transport along the ring isomorphism ρ preserves the equations and factorizations.
